name: Crontab-UI
description: Editing the plain text crontab is error-prone for managing jobs, e.g., adding jobs, deleting jobs, or pausing jobs. A small mistake can easily bring down all the jobs and might cost you a lot of time. With Crontab UI, it is very easy to manage crontab.

paths.name: Host Crontab Passthrough
paths.description: Path to host crontab files. Remove to skip modifying host machine crontabs.

paths.name: App Data
paths.description: Path to app data (logs and crontabs)

variables.name: Authentication - Username
variables.description: Username for authentication. Remove to disable authentication.

variables.name: Authentication - Password
variables.description: Password for authentication. Remove to disable authentication.

variables.name: Auto-Save
variables.description: Enable autosave of edited files. Proceed with caution.
